plan.palette_reason: Deep marsh green and bright leaf green define the robot, while isolated amber gives the eye maximum contrast.

body_shell.why: Bright green makes the compact round body the dominant mass.

eye_housing.why: A black socket cleanly isolates and frames the glowing eye.

eye.why: Amber is reserved for the focal eye and reads at one pixel.

upper_beak.why: Dark green distinguishes the gun barrel from the body.

lower_beak.why: Shadow treatment preserves the hooked lower silhouette without clutter.

scope.why: It matches the gun hardware while remaining distinct from the body.

upper_wing.why: The dark shoulder creates a readable overlapping armour mass.

lower_wing.why: Bright green keeps the folded outer wing visible against its dark shoulder.

legs.why: Dark legs anchor the body and preserve the crouched frog-like stance.

tail.why: A dark rear projection reads clearly without competing with the face.

priority.why: The single glowing eye is the primary identity pixel.
Its black surround must keep the eye isolated.
The projecting gun barrel carries the sniper concept.
The underside hook makes the barrel read as a bird beak.
The top sight reinforces the sniper role.
The feet and folded stance establish a wading-bird silhouette.
The shoulder is the main overlapping side feature.
The folded section conveys the compact crouch.
The small rear projection is useful but expendable in conflicts.
The large base mass can surrender edge pixels to defining features.

plan.summary: At 16 px, preserve the isolated amber eye, long dark gun-beak, top scope, round green shell, folded wing and squat feet.

significance.name: body_shell
significance.reason: The shell establishes the round body but is deliberately allowed to surrender pixels to more diagnostic projecting features.

significance.name: eye_housing
significance.reason: Its proportional rim is enough to frame the eye, and enlarging it would consume valuable face pixels.

significance.name: eye
significance.reason: The eye must remain a distinct filled 1-by-2-pixel light but must never be enlarged beyond proportional size.

overrides.why: user: eyes are fine at proportional size; never enlarge, only floor at two separate >= 1x2 rects

significance.name: upper_beak
significance.reason: The forward gun silhouette is the strongest identifier and may grow outward, though its modest cap keeps the muzzle snub rather than long.

significance.name: lower_beak
significance.reason: A slight outward boost preserves the two-part bird beak without letting the mandible compete with the gun barrel.

significance.name: scope
significance.reason: The sight reinforces the sniper theme but already has a clear top silhouette and should not displace the body or eye.

significance.name: upper_wing
significance.reason: This broad internal shoulder is supporting anatomy rather than a key silhouette cue, so it can scale normally and yield pixels.

significance.name: lower_wing
significance.reason: Its bent outer arc creates the characteristic crouched frog-like pose and needs enough thickness and bend to survive at 16 pixels.

significance.name: legs
significance.character: paired feet tucked beneath the body
significance.reason: Each visible leg instance needs a small horizontal foot under the shell, with the pair reading separately as the creature's crouched stance.

significance.name: tail
significance.reason: The tail adds direction but is expendable at tiny sizes and should not steal silhouette space from the gun or folded legs.

significance_summary: At 16 pixels the creature is recognised by a round shell, a bright single eye, a snub projecting gun-beak, and a thick folded limb ending in paired feet beneath the body.
